Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) in assays with organism Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID and assay organism. Require structures via INNER JOIN on compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
